subject.title: [Bug]: Default `bootstrapMaxChars=20000` + verbose auto-generated bootstrap content degrades tool dispatch on small/mid models

question: Should constrained local-model installs receive an automatic or guided lean bootstrap profile, and should that use existing limits and localModelLean or the new bootstrapTier contract?
rationale: Changing global bootstrap defaults can remove context existing users depend on, while adding bootstrapTier creates a new compatibility-sensitive configuration contract; source inspection cannot determine the intended product tradeoff.

options.title: Guide existing controls
options.body: Add current-model live validation plus onboarding or doctor guidance that applies existing per-agent bootstrap limits and localModelLean without adding another config key.

options.title: Adopt bootstrap tiers
options.body: Sponsor https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/22439 after defining fresh-install defaults, upgrade behavior, and live small-model proof.

options.title: Lower global defaults
options.body: Reduce bootstrap caps or generated template size for every install, accepting the risk that existing agents receive less persona, memory, or policy context.

recommendation.title: Guide existing controls
recommendation.body: Add current-model live validation plus onboarding or doctor guidance that applies existing per-agent bootstrap limits and localModelLean without adding another config key.

likelyOwner.reason: This choice sets global agent defaults and configuration direction across model classes.
